title: Glowing Dots Guide Friends

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: These glowing dots form a bright line toward east, don’t they?

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Yes, they sparkle like a secret path just waiting!

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: I can’t read the pattern alone, could you help please?

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Together we’ll match each dot and discover where it leads!

dialogue.speaker: wren
dialogue.text: Thank you, friend, for sharing your keen eyes today!

dialogue.speaker: juni
dialogue.text: Let’s follow the trail, adventure awaits beyond the meadow!
